name: GBIF API
summary: Species taxonomy and over 2 billion biodiversity occurrence records from institutions worldwide.
description: Includes the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy (name matching and search), occurrence records (specimens and observations with coordinates and dates), dataset and publisher registries, and download requests. Read endpoints need no authentication.

auth.notes: Reads need no auth. Downloads and registry writes need a free GBIF account (HTTP basic).

rate_limit.summary: No hard limit documented for reads. Occurrence search paginates only to an offset of 100,000; use the download API for more.

endpoints.summary: Match a name to the backbone taxonomy

license.name: Per dataset: CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC; API metadata CC0

agent_notes: Resolve a name to a taxonKey with /species/match first, then filter occurrences by taxonKey. Check the per-record license field before reuse; CSV only comes via the download API.
caveats: Occurrence licenses vary per record; some are non-commercial.
Occurrence search is capped at offset 100,000.
The OpenAPI spec is hosted at techdocs.gbif.org; a direct spec URL was not confirmed.
